datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Multi Spectral Instrument (MSI) Level 1 data
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2 Multi Spectral Instrument (MSI) Level 1 data has been used to implement the methodology here presented.

datasets.name: Aerial photos of electrical poles
datasets.verbatim: Electrical poles in displacement to be used as test-cases have been preventively identified and located using aerial photos (from 2015 to 2023) and relative additional information kindly provided by Geocart SPA (https://www.geocartspa.it/english/) (Figure 2).

methods.name: Robust Satellite Technique (RST)
methods.summary: An automated change detection method implemented in Google Earth Engine that characterizes signals (NDVI) under normal conditions using historical satellite data and identifies anomalies using locally generated self-adaptive thresholds (ALICE index).
methods.verbatim: The RST approach (Tramutoli 2007) is based on a multi-temporal analysis of historical satellite observations... The methodology, implemented in Google Earth Engine (GEE) environment, exploits the Copernicus Sentinel-2 platform to identify anomalous land cover variation

availability.author_statement: The datasets used and/or analyzed during the current study are available in the article/from the corresponding author on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for validation is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the RST methodology is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
